crew.overview: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.
crew.title: Anatomy of a Fall

crew.overview: Paris, in the early 1990s: a group of young activists is desperately tied to finding the cure against an unknown lethal disease. They target the pharmaceutical labs that are retaining potential cures, and multiply direct actions, with the hope of saving their lives as well as the ones of future generations.
crew.title: BPM (Beats per Minute)

details.biography:
Marie-Ange Luciani (born 1979) is a French film producer. In 2018, she was invited to join the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences. In 2024, she was nominated for two British Academy Film Awards for Best Film and Best Film Not in the English Language and the Academy Award for Best Picture for the film Anatomy of a Fall.
